outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Columbia County precinct results, November 8, 2022 general. 'Columbia County Commissioner #3' appears on all 13 voting precincts (ALTO, BROOKLYN, COLUMBIA, DAYTON, MUSTARD, PATIT, PING, RAINWATER, STAR, STARBUCK CITY, STARBUCK COUNTRY, TOUCHET, TUCANNON), the same 13 as Auditor, Sheriff and the District Court judge, 2,106 votes. 'Prescott Joint Park and Recreation District Proposition No. 1' appears only on ALTO and STARBUCK COUNTRY (7 votes in all).
